  - region "Simple English explanation of Line Through Two Points":
    - paragraph: In simple English
    - heading "Understand Line Through Two Points" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Two distinct points determine one line. (0,1) and (2,5) give slope 2, so y=2x+1. A third point is either on that line or it defines a different line. You can learn Line Through Two Points by trying one small example instead of long theory.
    - paragraph: Compute the slope from the two points, then write the point-slope equation and expand. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
    - paragraph: "In real life, roads: Two map points define a straight road. Watch out: Using one point twice to define a line. Two distinct points are needed."
